$doc: Single source of truth for cross-cutting integration constants shared by the full (mumble-tauri) client, the minimal (qt6ui) client and the React UI. Parsed at BUILD time: each crate's build.rs generates a Rust constants module into OUT_DIR, and mumble-tauri/build.rs additionally regenerates ui/src/utils/appConstants.ts. Nothing reads this file at runtime - changing a value requires a rebuild.
